title: Homeostatic Adaptive Intelligence: A Minimal Controller Comparison
primary_hypothesis: State-dependent adaptive control may predict switching and recovery across changing task demands beyond matched smooth and reinforcement-learning alternatives.
falsification_tests: Compare held-out switching behaviour, not just cusp-generated synthetic data.
Examine settings in which unnecessary switching, excess exploration or poor recovery harms the Trident-inspired controller.
Use independent synthetic null worlds and register model-complexity penalties.
